jobDescription:
Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid) Industry/Field: Retail Experience: 4-8 years Company: Tredence About Us: Tredence differentiates itself from other analytics services firms by enabling last mile adoption of insights. We drive true business impact by uniting our strengths in business analytics, data science, and software engineering. We help our clients deliver on the artificial intelligence imperative, in a practical and demystified way. To know more about us, visit: www.tredence.com Job Overview: As a Senior Full Stack Engineer at Tredence, you will design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack solutions tailored for the retail industry. Success in this role means delivering high-quality, maintainable software that drives business outcomes and user satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to integrate analytics and AI capabilities into client-facing applications. This role plays a crucial part in bridging technical delivery with business needs, supporting Tredence’s commitment to actionable insights. What will your role look like?
- Develop full-stack web applications using Angular and .Net frameworks, ensuring responsive and user-friendly interfaces.
- Design and implement microservices architecture to support scalable and maintainable backend services.
- Utilize Docker and Kubernetes to containerize and orchestrate applications for efficient deployment and management.
- Write and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests using Jasmine and Karma to ensure code quality and reliability.
- Collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, and product managers to translate analytics requirements into technical solutions.
- Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and continuous improvement initiatives to foster a high-performance engineering culture.
- Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for performance, scalability, and security. You will need:
- Demonstrate 4-8 years of professional experience in full-stack development with strong expertise in Angular and .Net technologies.
- Exhibit proficiency in developing and maintaining microservices-based architectures.
- Apply hands-on experience with containerization tools such as Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
- Write automated tests using Jasmine and Karma to support front-end development quality.
- Hold a BE/BTech degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Possess strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in hybrid work environments. Good to Have Skills:
- Utilize knowledge of Dev Ops practices and CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment workflows.
- Apply experience in retail domain applications to better understand client requirements and industry-specific challenges.
- Engage with cloud platforms like Azure or AWS for application hosting and management.
- Possess certifications related to Angular, .Net, or Kubernetes to demonstrate advanced expertise.
- Contribute to improving software development processes and mentoring junior engineers. Why you will love this job: At Tredence, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of analytics and engineering, driving impactful AI solutions in the retail industry. We foster a culture of continuous learning, offering diverse projects that challenge your skills and accelerate your career growth. Enjoy a flexible hybrid work environment that supports work-life balance and collaboration. Join a supportive team that values innovation, inclusivity, and solutions that make a real business difference.
